--- PDF page 546 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 546 
• 
Used to reduce acute complications of sickle cell disease  
 
AND 
 
2 - ONE of the following:  
• 
Patient is using Endari with concurrent hydroxyurea therapy  
• 
Patient is unable to take hydroxyurea due to a contraindication or intolerance  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient has had 2 or more painful sickle cell crises within the past 12 months
